descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S30 「现成单元 spec（unit.config.ts）：尝试次数和时间限制——拍照识别重试一次、没有回退，失败得慢的 Haiku 不再问，截止时间来自预算，语音连接重试一次，断掉的录音保留」 Existing unit specs (unit.config.ts): attempt counts and time limits — photo reading retried once with no fallback, a slow Haiku not asked again, deadlines from the budget, voice connect retried once, a dropped recordin …

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 A failure during photo capture: photo reading retries automatically; if it still fails, a clear message shows, nothing is added, and the photo isn't lost（UAT OAT-03 step 7；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4；UAT Empty & Failure States (Photo capture)；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 state 7）
  • U12 A failure during voice transcription: transcription retries automatically; the audio is kept until transcription succeeds; if it still fails, a clear message shows and the dictation isn't lost（UAT OAT-03 step 7；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4；TFA-94745 AC 4）
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral（UAT OAT-03 step 6；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3；TFA-94422 AC 2）
  • T3 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s（TFA-94422 AC 7；UAT 3.5）
  • U7 The output records which model produced it; each run records which AI ran each step (note model, speech-to-text engine, pre-round model, photo model, Ask AI model)（UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3；UAT 3.1；UAT 3.9；TFA-94422 AC 6；TFA-94423 AC 7）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given e2e/unit at origin/main e02167f, run with 'playwright test --config e2e/unit.config.ts' (not in cases/e2e-titles.tsv, not run by spec-matrix.mjs)

When Run the titles below

Then RT-05: without a fallback (the vision path) a temporary failure is retried once, then thrown. RT-07: a primary that took 10 s or more to fail is not asked again and the time goes to the fallback. RT-08: each attempt's deadline comes from what is left of the 30 s budget, never below 8 s. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Deterministic evidence for OAT-03 step 7 (U11 server retry, U12 connect retry and kept audio) and for T3 / Q4 (RT-07, RT-08); it does not show the screen (S18, S19) or a real microphone (S19). RT-07 is the rule Q4 asks about: recorded as main's behaviour, not judged
